review.reason: The report adequately answers the seven diagnostic issues and concluding questions within its exposed TRAIN/VAL scope. Independent checks confirm endpoint scores, prediction ensembles, initialized gradient mechanisms, source identities, sampling counts, and report integrity. Causal attribution remains explicitly unresolved; historical conclusions and lineage are preserved, and the conditional follow-up is bounded and unapproved. This verdict approves the diagnostic report only.
residual_risks: Historical preservation verification was partial: 152 of 383 files matched, including the r3 ZIP; 231 campaign/E-drive files were access-denied. Of 133 consumed-input hashes, 39 matched and 94 were inaccessible. Full preservation claims therefore also rely on inspected parent evidence.
Temporary writes were blocked. Four diagnostic tests and four integration tests requiring temporary files were NOT_RUN independently; the recorded builder 31-test result was inspected.
Saved-state backward probes, historical forecast fidelity, raw cohort reconstruction, and TRAIN endpoint inference were inspected rather than rerun because their historical inputs were inaccessible.

Missing optimization curves and historical sample logs, two fixed representation batches, sparse TRAIN errors, dependent windows, and repeatedly inspected VAL limit attribution and generalization. Single-seed conditional thresholds are exploratory continuation screens.
The requested model and effort are recorded below, not independently proven by this review. Parent runtime verification remains separate. Any substantive change requires a fresh review.
